title: K″ remediation — Unicode lookaround boundaries in DEADLINE_RE/TEMPORAL_NUM_RE/CONSTRAINT_RE/LOCAL_SOURCE_RE/output-language markers; VI durations ('trong vòng 30 giờ', 'trước 10 giờ') mint deadlines and are masked from quantity extraction — ceilings can no longer invert into floors
description: Final independent K″ correctness audit on PR #154 HEAD 0a4e204. Root cause: JS \b is ASCII-only, so every boundary adjacent to a non-ASCII-edged Vietnamese lexeme was dead. Fixed: (1) DEADLINE_RE — 'giờ' (ends ờ) dead in four alternations → 'trước 10 giờ'/'trong vòng 30 giờ' minted no deadline and leaked 10/30 into the bare-quantity scan (phantom floor); all \b converted to Unicode lookarounds, phút/giây units added. (2) TEMPORAL_NUM_RE — same 'giờ' edge dead on both branches → durations masked neither on the contract side nor the task side (a task 'trong 30 giờ' could satisfy an unrelated floor); lookarounds + 'trước N <unit>' and 'ngày|tháng|day|month N' date-ordinal masks. (3) CONSTRAINT_RE — 'không quá'(á), 'chỉ'(ỉ), 'ngoại trừ'(ừ), and left-edge '<='/'≤' all dead → 'không quá 50 USD' minted no constraint and fell into the preserved-obligation backstop, inverting a ceiling into a floor. (4) LOCAL_SOURCE_RE — right-edge group 'cục bộ'(ộ)/'dữ liệu'(ệ) dead. (5) output-language markers — 'kết quả'(ả) and 'đọc'(left-edge) dead → VI source/output directive misclassification. (6) llm-planner connective counter — 'và'(à)/'sau đó'(ó) dead. Sweep script scripts/dev-verification/b-boundary-sweep.cjs audits every \b-adjacent non-ASCII edge in src/pair; remaining flags classified as false positives (lookahead-bound digits, bare alternations by design). Adversarial probes H21–H30 prove duration numbers cannot mint quantity floors nor satisfy unrelated requirements, dead constraint/marker edges are live, and EN behavior is unchanged. Independent review follow-ups: ONLY_VI_RE auxiliary skip-chain + VI function-word stop-set so 'chỉ cần/muốn/được' no longer mint unsatisfiable onlyTerms (H31–H33); ordinal masks extended to thứ/tuần/quý/week/năm + dd/mm tails with per-unit digit bounds (H34–H36); 'giây' deadline-unit consistency (H35). Deterministic authority/fail-closed semantics preserved; no weakening of coverage checks; zero new provider invocations.
